title: One more thing
titleEn: Using One more thing to add a final related point

source.file: Sentence Structure 183 - 「One more thing」補充最後一點.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: [Main message.] + One more thing: / — + complete sentence

formulas.formula: [Main message.] + One more thing: / — + complete sentence

example: One more thing—don't forget to lock the door before you leave.
exampleZh: 還有一件事——離開前別忘了鎖門。

examples.en: One more thing—don't forget to lock the door before you leave.
examples.zh: 還有一件事——離開前別忘了鎖門。
examples.highlight: One more thing—don't forget to lock the door before you leave.

rules.zh: 用它帶出一個與前文有關的額外重點，而不是突然轉到完全無關的話題。
rules.en: Use it for one extra point that is connected to what you have just said.

rules.zh: 後面可以接陳述、請求、指示、提醒或問題，但內容必須完整。
rules.en: The words after it may form a statement, request, instruction, reminder or question, but the content must be complete.

rules.zh: 冒號適合清楚、較中性的補充；破折號適合較口語、較有即時提醒感的補充。 本練習接受兩種正確用法。
rules.en: Use a colon for a neat, neutral addition. Use an em dash for a quicker or more conversational afterthought. Both are accepted in this exercise.

rules.zh: 冒號或破折號後通常用小寫字母開始；但 I、人名或專有名詞仍要大寫。
rules.en: After the colon or dash, begin with a lower-case letter unless the first word normally needs a capital letter, such as I or a name.

rules.zh: 通常要刪去 also、too、in addition 或 another point 等字眼，因為 One more thing 已經表示「補充」。 Punctuation examples 標點例子 Colon 冒號 （還有一件事：請在星期五前交功課。） Em dash 破折號 （還有一件事——我們需要大家明天前提交意見。）
rules.en: Usually remove words such as also, too, in addition or another point, because “One more thing” already shows that you are adding information. thing Punctuation examples Colon One more thing: please submit your homework by Friday. Em dash One more thing—we'll need everyone's feedback by tomorrow.
examples: One more thing: please submit your homework by Friday.
One more thing—we'll need everyone's feedback by tomorrow.

benefits.zh: It makes the extra point easy to notice 讓補充重點更顯眼 聽者或讀者會立即知道，接下來還有一個最後的重要細節。
benefits.en: It makes the extra point easy to notice The listener or reader immediately knows that one final detail is coming.

benefits.zh: It keeps your message organised 令說話或訊息更有組織 你可以先完成主要內容，再補充提醒或細節，令整段說話或訊息不會顯得凌 亂。
benefits.en: It keeps your message organised You can finish the main message first, then add a reminder or detail without making the message feel messy.

benefits.zh: It is useful for reminders and requests 很適合提醒和提出要求 在日常對話、電郵或會議中，當你要補充最後一項指示、問題或要求時，這個 句型很自然。
benefits.en: It is useful for reminders and requests The structure sounds natural when you need to add a last instruction, question or request in daily conversation, an email or a meeting.

benefits.zh: It helps you avoid repeating “also” 避免重複使用 also 你不需要每句都以 Also 或 And 開始，能令句式有更多變化。
benefits.en: It helps you avoid repeating “also” Instead of beginning several sentences with “Also” or “And”, you can use this phrase to vary your sentence opening.

benefits.zh: It supports speaking fluency 幫助口語更流暢 One more thing 是一個可直接使用的說話框架，讓你在說話時有一點時間 整理最後一個想法。 Before and after 前後比較 （請今天交表格。另外，請在表格上寫上你的電話號碼。→ 請今天交表格。還有一件事——請在表格上寫上你 的電話號碼。）
benefits.en: It supports speaking fluency “One more thing …” is a ready-made speaking frame. It gives you a moment to organise the final idea while you are talking. One more thing Before and after Please submit the form today. Also, write your phone number on it. → Please submit the form today. One more thing—write your phone number on it.
examples: Please submit the form today. Also, write your phone number on it. → Please submit the
